sources.title: Boltz-2 - biolm.ai
sources.snippet: Boltz-2 is a GPU-accelerated, structure- and affinity-aware biomolecular co-folding model for proteins, nucleic acids, and small-molecule ligands. It predicts 3D complex structures with per-complex and per-chain confidence metrics (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM, PAE, PDE), and optionally returns single and pairwise embeddings.
